about_the_game:
Transform any space into your library

Block out distractions with a custom soundscape

Import your own books or browse the public domain:

  • The Holy Bible – American Standard Version (ASV)

  • The Holy Bible – Douay-Rheims Version (DRV)

  • The Holy Bible – King James Version (KJV)

name: Virtual Reader (Personal VR Library)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12500H or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
  • Additional Notes: Lock to 72 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR
